import fs from 'node:fs';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import {Packer} from './tools/roadroller-2.1.0/package/index.mjs';
process.chdir(import.meta.dirname);
const out='dist/v002-closure-roadroller';
const old=fs.readFileSync('dist/v001-terser/jsnes-lite-standalone.html','utf8');
const header=old.slice(0,old.indexOf('<script>\n')).trim();
const setup='document.body.innerHTML='+JSON.stringify(header.replace(/^<!doctype html>/,''))+';\n';
const options=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(out+'/advanced-dynamic-native.page.roadroller.parameters.json','utf8')).options;
delete options.resourcePool;
const packer=new Packer([{data:setup+fs.readFileSync(out+'/advanced-dynamic-native.min.js','utf8'),type:'js',action:'eval'}],options);
const decoder=packer.makeDecoder();
const packed=decoder.firstLine+'\n'+decoder.secondLine;
const rebuilt=Buffer.from('<!doctype html><meta charset=utf-8><body><script>'+packed.replace(/<\/script/gi,'<\\/script')+'</script>');
const actual=fs.readFileSync(out+'/jsnes-lite.min.html');
const unchangedOldFiles=fs.readdirSync('dist').filter(n=>fs.statSync('dist/'+n).isFile()).every(n=>fs.readFileSync('dist/'+n).equals(fs.readFileSync('dist/v001-terser/'+n)));
const result={savedParametersReproduceExactHTML:rebuilt.equals(actual),bytes:actual.length,sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(actual).digest('hex'),oldRootOutputsUnchanged:unchangedOldFiles};
fs.writeFileSync(out+'/verification-build.json',JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');
console.log(result);
if(!result.savedParametersReproduceExactHTML||!unchangedOldFiles)process.exitCode=1;
